decision: V1 has lower selection all-request and present-only edit error than V2. Keep V2 as a documented pilot; no switching or tuning after confirmation.
known_limits_before_confirmation: V1 worsens target gain accuracy and mean direct SDR relative to independent extraction
All three selection absent requests still exceed the false-extraction threshold
Source-level recordings have weak class labels; no physical-source purity guarantee
Only 10 selection scenes, with source reuse; no broad statistical or subjective-quality claim
Long/natural/stereo product evidence is separate from source-reference confirmation
failure_interpretation: Nonpositive all-request mean improvement over the strongest comparable non-oracle baseline does not establish efficacy. Keep present/absent strata, gains, per-scene/per-query failures and source-reuse sensitivity beside any positive bounded result. No retuning model/scalar/metrics/edit subset on confirmation.
